hypothesis: On upstream main, cancellation abandons admitted native work: cua_driver_operation_cancel_v1 signals OperationState, spawn_completion calls work.abort(), and direct stdio MCP ignores notifications/cancelled. kvnloo/cua#84 (AdmissionHold + spawn_blocking_owned) keeps desktop capacity owned until native exit. Neither may let queued cancelled work enter the native closure, or let a late or foreign cancel reach another issuance.

M.description: upstream main as is; barrier native closure = plain tokio spawn_blocking (the primitive production tools use)
M.runs_at: detached worktree at tree_commit (base + OWN-09 test files only)

P.description: upstream main + kvnloo/cua#84; barrier native closure = cua_driver_core::tool::spawn_blocking_owned
P.runs_at: lane branch head after this PREREG commit; its libs/cua-driver tree must equal tree_commit's

method.forced_path: barrier-backed host tool registered as press_key through DriverHostOptions.register_host_tools on CuaDriver::try_create_configured_for_host (explicit Standard-only ceiling, no permission env override). Route: CuaDriver::call_tool -> NativeAbiDriver::invoke -> cua_driver_invoke_v1 -> spawn_completion -> DriverRuntime lifecycle read guard -> ToolRegistry dispatch desktop coordinator -> Tool::invoke -> native closure. Trusted-session rows use create_trusted_session -> cua_driver_session_invoke_v1. R8 uses cua_driver_core::server::handle_request_with_transport_session over the SDK.
method.cancel_route: caller task abort -> SDK future drop -> OperationGuard::drop -> cua_driver_operation_cancel_v1 -> OperationState::cancel -> spawn_completion select -> work.abort(). Attribution event: invocation-dropped:<id> logged by the barrier invocation's Drop (the dispatch frame lives on the ABI executor, so only the abort can drop it early).
method.oracle: fixture-owned native closure entry/exit counters + target journal written only by the native closure (or the target's delayed commit thread) + ordered ledger. No Driver result is used as a verdict except the caller-visible outcome where a row is about what the caller receives (R4/R5 'completed ok', R8 'response delivered').
method.phase_proof: channels and ledger events; bounded negative windows (300 ms) only decide when the harness releases a barrier, never the verdict

passes.stress: cargo test ... -- --test-threads=8, OWN09_ITERS=20 (tests contend for the per-process runtime lock; one Driver runtime and one desktop coordinator per process)

R1.claim: cancel or abandon while queued: the work never enters the native closure
R1.kill_gate: queued cancelled work enters the native closure
R1.iteration_pass: admitted:2 absent AND counter[2]==[0,0] AND native-exit:1 before admitted:3 (cancel_race: admission winner OR counter[2]==[0,0])

R2.claim: after admission, capacity stays owned until the native closure exits
R2.kill_gate: admitted capacity becomes reusable before native exit

R3.reason: held-input cleanup exactly once needs a macOS-first target-side drag/mouse-up oracle; not attempted

R4.claim: a late cancel cannot reach a later issuance
R4.kill_gate: a late cancel reaches the wrong issuance
R4.iteration_pass: later outcome is_error==false AND invoke-end:2 before invocation-dropped:2 AND counter[2]==[1,1]

R5.claim: a foreign transport or session cannot cancel, end or substitute into this operation (kvnloo/cua#36 cancellation cross-session row)
R5.kill_gate: a foreign cancel reaches this issuance
R5.iteration_pass: own outcome ok AND invoke-end:1 before invocation-dropped:1 AND foreign mutation never admitted AND foreign end refused AND journal landed ids == [1]

R6.claim: session end or shutdown does not claim readiness before admitted native work exits, with and without a cancelled caller
R6.kill_gate: readiness is claimed before admitted work drains

readiness_events.end_session: session-cleanup (core session-end hook fired for the session's runtime key)

R6.iteration_pass: readiness event observed AND native-exit:1 before it

R7.claim: admitted -> caller loses the ack -> first fresh read unchanged -> native work exits and the effect lands later: the unchanged read neither frees capacity nor authorizes a second mutation; exactly 1 effect
R7.kill_gate: a second mutation is authorized by an unchanged read
R7.iteration_pass: first-read:0 AND native-exit:1 before admitted:2 AND exactly 1 applied effect in the target journal (control_ack: exactly 1 applied effect)
R7.characterization_note: effect committed by the target after native exit; native-exit ownership cannot cover it; non-gating

R8.claim: notifications/cancelled sent during an in-flight call (SDK/core level)
R8.classification: IGNORED = in-flight response delivered and dispatch frame not dropped early; HONORED otherwise
R8.real_stdio: NOT_RUN unless a barrier-backed tool is reachable over the stdio binary without modifying production

row_rules.PASS: every primary variant PASS 20/20 in main AND in stress, AND every broken control FAIL 20/20 in main (a row with no broken control for that arm cannot PASS)
row_rules.FAIL: any primary iteration FAIL in either pass (a kill-gate violation), provided every listed positive control PASSes 20/20 in main
row_rules.INVALID: harness errors, a broken control not detected 20/20, or a FAIL without its positive control
row_rules.evidence_labels: every row: SOURCE + UNIT/FIXTURE (R3 BLOCKED, R8 REAL NOT_RUN)

disposition_rule.KEEP: P passes R1, R2, R4, R5, R6 and R7 (evidence for #84 slice-A promotion, with the CONFIRMED_GAP on M)
disposition_rule.REVISE: P passes some rows and none FAIL (name them)
disposition_rule.KILL: P violates any kill gate (any gating row FAIL on P)

M.R2: FAIL (guard dropped with aborted dispatch frame)
M.R6: FAIL on *_after_cancel (lifecycle read guard and session dispatch guard dropped with the aborted frame)
M.R7: FAIL (retry admitted while original native work is stuck; 2 effects)

P.R6: FAIL on *_after_cancel (AdmissionHold owns only the desktop coordinator, not the lifecycle read guard or the session dispatch guard)
